newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index eases in lighter trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index eases in lighter trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Friday closed down 0.25 percent in lighter trade, bourse sources said.
The 30-share index closed at 615.81 from 617.35 on Thursday.
Volume was 690,000 dinars versus 1.669 million dinars.
Banque Nationale Agricole was up 1.12 dinar to 31.67 dinars. Banque de l'Habitat rose 1.02 dinar to 35.07.
UBCI bank was down 0.82 dinar to 53.18 and BTEI bank fell 0.69 dinar to 22.43.
